0.description: Fixed an issue where the bloodforged alembic of infernal power was giving an incorrect resilience and the mythic version did not have PvE power akin to the Heroic Version.
Fixed an issue where one with the hunt would not increase the damage of mangle.
Fixed an issue where abilities that scaled with ranged attack power, (traps, mongoose bites, etc) would not be increased by hunter's mark.
Fixed an issue where the high speed chase mystic enchantment would not increase the damage of intercept.

Added a max absorb to Runed Fungal Cap, this means you can only absorb 200 a hit out of the 1200 damage, meaning the duration on the parry rating should be a bit higher. The absorb is reduced by 75% outside of PvE content.
All demon transformation scrolls (tmog for your warlock pets) would not have a cooldown.
Fixed an issue where the golden skillcards for PW:S, Drain Soul, Curse of the Elements and Soul Link would not function properly.
fixed an issue where some trinkets would put Blood Fury (orc racial) on a 2 minute cooldown, instead of the intended 20 second cooldown.
Fixed an issue where the stay frosty mystic enchant would not allow players to gain benefit from the fingers of frost mystic enchant, which increases your chance to trigger fingers of frost.
Fixed an issue where Raiment's of Nature's breath in the mythic version had resillience rating instead of haste rating.
Fixed an issue where players could not use a voidwalker card if they already had another card (golden or not) active.
Fixed an issue where totem of the void was giving too low SP to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning
slightly increased the ppm to 1.75 from 1.5 on Mythic Blinkstrike (original blinkstrike is 1.5 PPM). Increased weapon damage to retain its spot as a Mythic weapon.
Fixed an issue where Bloodforged Darkmoon Faire decks did not have their item level increased to 115.
Fixed an issue where centered epic enchantment was functioning incorrectly and not always giving the proc effect.
Corrected the proc effect of the Bangle of Endless Blessing it now correctly gives and increases mana regen from your mp5 while casting by 25%. This effect has a 45 second ICD.
Fixed an issue where a rare case where players would lose an arena team and not be able to purchase PvP gear for honor.
Fixed the Sous Chef achievement, to gain this achievement, just learn a new cooking recipe!
Fixed an issue where Controlled Explosion would not increase explosive shot's single target damage.
Fixed a client-sided crash by clicking on hiden achievements.
Fixed an issue where the Eye of Magtheridon on the normal version had the wrong ICD. It now abides by the correct ICD of 10 seconds.
Libram of Saints Departed trinket now has a socket. (Previously was the same as the normal version)
Fixed an issue where Dominant Word Shield would consume Inner Focus, it should now only be consumed & benefitted by PW:S.
fixed an issue where revitalize sometimes would stop functioning.

[Serpentshrine] [Leotheras the Blind] Leotheras will no longer reset threat when switching form, phases or ending his Whirlwind ability.

0.description:
Pending Restart: Consortium Monthly Membership benefits have been reworked. 

Friendly rewards remain unchanged.
Honored rewards an extra uncommon gem (in comparison to friendly) and a 50% chance at an uncut rare gem.
Revered rewards an extra uncommon gem (in comparison to honored) and guarantees an uncut rare gem.
Exalted rewards no extra uncommon gems (in comparison to revered) but guarantees 3 to 4 uncut rare gems.

This is now a quest chain and resets every month, meaning players must first complete the Friendly quest, next month they will be able to complete the Honored Quest. This cycle continues until players will be able to complete the exalted quest each month.

Fixed an issue where there were discrepancies on what could or could not proc the Eye of Magtheridon trinket. Triggered Spells like Penance and Holy shock can now proc the Heroic and Ascended Versions and thus have mirrored proc behavior to the normal version of the trinket.
Fixed an exploit where players could use unbounded mindflay while using twilight paragon.
Fixed an issue where Presence of Mind was reducing the damage dealt by hailstorm by 15%.
Fixed an issue where Presence of Mind was not letting you instantly cast Hailstorm.
Fixed an exploit with Blizzard and Presence of Mind combined with the snow storm RE which allowed players to deal massive amounts of DPS.
